title: The + adds Labor and Parts fields holding the same person
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field.
  2. Hover over the + button.
  3. Click the + button.
  4. Click "Sales Representative - Parts" in the menu.
  5. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a + button shows to the right of the field.
  • Step 2: the tooltip "Add representative" shows.
  • Step 3: a menu opens below the + with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts"; the tooltip is not shown while the menu is open.
  • Step 4: the menu closes and the one field becomes two, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts". Both read {Sales-rep-A}. Neither dropdown has opened on its own. Both labels show in full. "Sales Representative - Parts" has a remove x to its right; "Sales Representative - Labor" has no button, and the + is gone.
  • Step 5: after the reload both fields still show and both read {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R1: “A + button sits to the right of the Sales Representative field: the design system's Tertiary button in its small icon-only size, 32px square with 8px corners, showing the Lucide plus icon at 20px.”
  • S2-R3: “Hovering the + shows the tooltip "Add representative". The tooltip does not show while the menu is open.”
  • S2-R4: “Clicking the + opens a menu below it with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts". Clicking outside the menu or pressing Escape closes it without a change.”
  • S2-R5: “Picking "Sales Representative - Parts" closes the menu and replaces the one field with two fields, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • S2-R6: “Both fields start with the person who was in the one field, or "Unassigned" if it was empty. Adding the Parts field on its own changes nobody's credit.”
  • S2-R7: “Neither dropdown opens on its own after the Parts field is added.”
  • S2-R8: “A remove x sits to the right of "Sales Representative - Parts", in the column the + uses: the same Tertiary button, 32px square, showing the Lucide x icon at 20px, grey at rest with a light fill on hover.”
  • S2-R10: “While the two fields show, the + is not shown, because there is nothing left to add. "Sales Representative - Labor" has no button beside it.”
  • S2-R14: “Both labels show in full on the card, never cut off.”
  • S2-R15: “The work order keeps both fields when the page is reloaded or reopened, including when both hold the same person.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
